title: 3D Objects
description: A way to make the minecraft weapons less boring
body:
A Texture pack that revamp the old 2D textures of Minecraft with new and better made 3D textures  and more accurate comparing them to the 3D world around them.
All the textures(beta 1.0):
- All netherite Weapons
- All diamond Weapons
- All the other swords
- All the other spears
- A bigger mace
